examples.en: On closer inspection , the notes proved to be forgeries.
examples.zh: 经进一步检查发现钞票都是伪造的。

examples.en: Engineers carried out a thorough inspection of the track.
examples.zh: 工程师对轨道进行了彻底检查。

examples.en: An inspection of his rig showed that three of the brakes were faulty.
examples.zh: 对他的重型卡车的检查显示有3处刹车存在问题。
